summary: Fixes a problem in ICE where an agent may run out of candidate pairs to check and conclude that connectivity has failed, even though more candidates could still be discovered. The document makes agents wait a little longer before giving up. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Imagine giving up on finding your friend because the first places you checked were empty, though a hint was still on its way. This document tells the program to be patient a little longer before saying it failed.

questions: why does ice fail too early
